data.name: Half Day Charter 4hrs Boston Whaler
data.headline: Up to 6 guests • Private, captained charter • Most popular!
data.description:
#Explore unseen sights, only accessible by boat!										

##What's Included				
- Captain
- Fuel
- Cooler and ice
- Bottled water
- Soda and chips
- SunChill Island Float 

##The Vessel					
- Premium  Bow-rider
- Boston Whaler "The unsinkable legend"
- 230 Vantage
- Plenty of comfortable seating for 6 passengers.
- Bow seating area with lounge backrest / sun pad area.
- Shade lounger / bench seat
- Additional to make this boat ride even better
- Bluetooth radio connection 
- Fresh water boat shower
- Prep station with fresh water sink 
- Large shaded area

##Our mission				
Let's get away from reality and explore what it feels to be out of cell phone range in Paradise!

meeting_point.address: 811 Palm Ave Cswy #10 Key West, FL US 33040

data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellations made 72 hours or more before scheduled departure date will receive a full refund.
Cancellations made between 48 and 72 hours will recieve a 50% refund.
No refund given for reservations made within 48 hours of departure date.
Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.
